senses.gloss: (= מַה לָךְ) what is it to thee?; of no practical value.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 150a:13">Sabb. 150ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>חשבונות של מ׳ ושל מה בכך</he> (Ms. M. <he>מה לך</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) accounts of ‘what is it to thee?’ and of ‘what is in it?’, i.e. for no practical purpose. [Oth. opin., v. Ar.]
